description: Paid (x402, 0.001 USD). Returns the MNEMOS ensemble's latest decision output — the current decision set produced by the engine's signal modules. Takes no inputs besides the caller's payment_signature; without a valid payment proof the call returns the route's 402 payment requirements. Read-only: it reports stored decision output and places no orders.

payment_signature.description: Caller-supplied x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: mnemos_decisions
title: MNEMOS Ensemble Decisions
